problem: Let $T:[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]⟶[\begin{aligned}3x+y \\ x+2y \\ -2x+7y\end{aligned}]$ be a linear transformation. Determine the value of $k$ for which the vector $v=[\begin{aligned}9 \\ 8 \\ k\end{aligned}]$ belongs to $\text{Im}(T).$
worked_solution:
The vector $v$ belongs to $\text{Im}(T)$ if there exists a vector $u=[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]$ such that $T(u)=v.$ 

Therefore, we must have

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}3x+y \\ x+2y \\ -2x+7y\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}9 \\ 8 \\ k\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

This gives the following system of equations:

$$
{\begin{aligned}3x+y=9 \\ x+2y=8 \\ -2x+7y=k.\end{aligned}
$$

From the second equation, we get $x=8-2y$, which we substitute into the first equation to get 

$$
\begin{aligned}3x+y & =9 \\ 3(8-2y)+y & =9 \\ -5y & =-15 \\ y & =3.\end{aligned}
$$

Hence, 

$$
\begin{aligned}x & =8-2y \\  & =8-2(3) \\  & =2.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we substitute $x=2$ and $y=3$ into the third equation and obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}-2x+7y & =k \\ -2(2)+7(3) & =k \\ k & =17.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $v\in \text{Im}(T)$ when $k=17.$
